review: A DPS ID that benefits from having Rupture stacks on enemies. For a 00 rarity ID, he has a very high Clashing power and also reduces the enemy Offense Level. With 4 - 7 Speed, he can, in a way, make clashing for the whole team a lot easier. Let us take a look at his skills! - Skill 1 - Bat Strike - 1 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 11, Conditionals Met – 16. - Skill 2 - Smackdown - 2 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 14, Conditionals Met – 19. Net neutral Rupture Count application. - Skill 3 - Relentless - 4 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 12, Conditionals Met – 20. Negative Rupture Count application. As he relies heavily on enemies having Rupture, it will take some time to ramp up those Rupture Count and Potency - which due to how Rupture works in a Focused Encounter can be achieved easily, however in a normal Human Encounter, it is VERY hard to do the same.
